Class AccountContactRelationSelector

public inherited sharing class AccountContactRelationSelector

Selector class for the AccountContactRelation object. Provides centralized SOQL query methods for retrieving account-contact relations by Id, account, notification subscriptions, external Ids, emails, and BlazeBite agent roles. Returns results wrapped in a Result inner class extending Tools.QueryResult.

Methods

public static QueryAggregateResult countBlazeBiteAgents(Set<Id> accountIds)

Counts active BlazeBite agent contacts grouped by account. Filters by active relations with email, indirect contacts (IsDirect = FALSE), BlazeBite account flag, positive commission percentage, and the BlazeBite Agent role.

Parameters:
    accountIds – The set of Account Ids to count agents for

Returns:
    QueryAggregateResult: Aggregate result with AccountId and AgentsCount fields

Since:
    11/16/2023

public static AccountContactRelationSelector.Result getBlazeBiteAgents(Set<Id> accountIds)

Retrieves active BlazeBite agent AccountContactRelation records for the given accounts. Applies the same filters as countBlazeBiteAgents and returns Id, AccountId, ContactId, and CommissionPercentage__c fields.

Parameters:
    accountIds – The set of Account Ids to retrieve agents for

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing the matching agent relation records

Since:
    06/16/2024

public static AccountContactRelationSelector.Result getNotificationContacts(
  Id accountId,
  String notificationTag
)

Retrieves AccountContactRelation records for contacts subscribed to a specific email notification tag on a given account. Filters by active relations with valid email addresses.

Parameters:
    accountId – The Account Id to filter relations by
    notificationTag – The EmailNotifications__c multi-select picklist value to match

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing the matching relation records

public static AccountContactRelationSelector.Result getRelations(
  Set<Id> accountIds,
  Set<String> contactExternalIds,
  Set<String> contactEmails
)

Retrieves active AccountContactRelation records matching the given account Ids and contacts identified by external Ids or email addresses. Uses bind variables with Database.queryWithBinds for dynamic condition building.

Parameters:
    accountIds – The set of Account Ids to filter relations by
    contactExternalIds – The set of Contact.ExternalId__c values to match
    contactEmails – The set of contact email addresses to match against Email or OtherEmail__c

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing the matching relation records

Since:
    08/15/2025

public static AccountContactRelationSelector.Result getRelationsWithEmail(Id accountId)

Retrieves all active AccountContactRelation records for a given account where the contact has an email address. Results are ordered by EmailNotificationsPriority__c ascending, then Contact.Name ascending.

Parameters:
    accountId – The Account Id to filter relations by

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing the matching relation records
